applies_to: a Snowball-family SFT checkpoint served with snowball-eval-main on 2xB200 (4c/64G per GPU), fixed budget 256 (128 agents/GPU), capped protocol, launched from main with example_sft_snowball.json (suites lean or full)
how: python gen/campaign_rate.py --dispatch <dispatch_root>/<campaign>-<model> --expect aa_evals/campaign/expected/sft_snowball.json; exit 2 = some check WARNs. Ranges: 'measured' = observed on the runs in `sources`; 'estimated' = measured numbers adjusted for what main changed since (each says how). Times are hours after the dispatcher's first start.

gen_tok_s_per_gpu.basis: snowball-eval-main replay (#478, rt-vllm results/snowball, 4c shape): 5,252-5,334 tok/s/GPU at 100-103 running/GPU (128 agents), 5,781-6,267 at 156-160 (192 agents). Live 0.20.1 (snowball-eval): trimmed 4,020-4,720 at 85-100 running/GPU (rtab-sb2-0p33b, #535 check); untrimmed 6,064 / 5,017 / 4,324 at 98 / 94 / 95 (ucab, 15-45 min). Main = 0.20.1 x 1.13 at 128 agents (#550). Not checked while HLE holds > 25% of the attempts in flight (full set): HLE-only on 2-GPU snowball-eval read 2.4k down to 0.46k tok/s/GPU at 124 -> 60 running/GPU (hlepilot-sb-full, sbtrim samples), long single sequences, no reference.
gen_tok_s_per_gpu.if_warn: below every 0.20.1 window at this load: check job.json (teacher snowball-eval-main, cuda_cap 10.0), prefix hit and KV (thrash), host CPU (run-queue), the node (bad-nodes list); compare with /data/aai/uni/uni-serving/sbmain/samples.jsonl

prefix_hit.basis: replay of real m5l Pi traffic: 0.943-0.960 on main at 128-192 agents (0.828-0.956 on 0.20.1). Live mixed-lane values (single-turn lanes share the engines) are not recorded yet: the first snowball-eval-main campaign records them (sbmain sampler).
prefix_hit.if_warn: one window can dip during a launch wave (cold first turns, first ~15 min): re-check in 5 min; sustained < 0.85 at full load with KV > 0.9 = thrash -> tell the coordinator (budget 256 is the measured knee)

kv_max.basis: main replay 0.44-0.75 (128-192 agents); 0.20.1 live 0.21-0.59 at 256 on 2 GPUs (M5 ladder 11-18 00:0x)
kv_max.if_warn: KV nearly full: preemptions follow; check waiting and prefix hit

waiting.basis: 0 in every replay level and live window at 128 agents/GPU (max_num_seqs 256 per engine)
waiting.if_warn: requests queue at the engine: KV full or max_num_seqs reached; check kv_max and the dispatcher budget

healthy_after_s.basis: snowball-eval 2xB200 starts 11-16..19: 144-243 s incl. checkpoint staging 22-101 s (12 server jobs), 354 s with a slow 156-s staging (rtab); snowball-eval-main with a staged venv 145-149 s (1 GPU, #554 A/B), not seeded (first start of its engine-cache key) 412 s incl. 130-s staging (rtvllm-sbmain-smoke2); the 0.20.1 starts above were not seeded either (small compile)
healthy_after_s.if_warn: over 10 min: look at serve.log / vllm.log (staging stuck on /data, JIT compile = cold cache, a bad node)

host_cores_share.basis: trimmed (4c/GPU) 4.1-4.6 of 8 cores at 85-100 running/GPU (rtab); untrimmed 2.9-4.6 of 16 (uval p50 2.9 / p95 3.5, ucab 4.2 / 4.6)

host_hard_share.basis: hard memory 16.5-20.2 GiB per 2-GPU server in every Snowball eval (limit 128 GiB trimmed, 256 untrimmed)

dispatch.basis: longest gap between a lane's starts: uval 11-32 min, ucab 1-13 min (main e678b535); 79-80 min for AB in sb2-2p2b/4p8b was the pre-#529 Pi-growth bug. Single-turn suites, AutomationBench and GDPval had 0 infra outcomes in all 11 runs. TB2.1: verifier bootstrap timeouts (below) plus one-off verifier_no_reward / pi_backend_* / worker_stopped (<= 1 per run). CritPt / TB-Sci-lite worker_stopped (36-72 / 7-8) in sb2-0p33b/1p0b are the suites stopped mid-run by hand (11-17 drop), 18k-3p0b 1-2 pi_backend_timeout.

tb21.infra: verifier_bootstrap_timeout follows the proxy download rate of the run's window (val-codeab): 0 at 6-8 MB/s (sb2-* 11-17/18), 13 / 38 / 131 at 0.65 / 0.29 / 0.22 MB/s (sb-full, uval, ucab). With suites.tb_toolchain_bundle (#543, 60/89 tasks verify offline, torch-class bootstraps included) expected <= 2% (estimated; rtab with #543: 0).
tb21.if_infra: check suites.tb_toolchain_bundle is set (offline verifiers, #543); infra attempts retry automatically and are not scored, but a task whose every attempt ends infra drops out of the resolved-only score (ucab: 11 items unresolved)
tb21.kind: measured lean (uval, sb2-2p2b, sb2-4p8b); full estimated from m5l-sb-full (4xB200) list-scheduled on 256 slots (5.2-5.6 h) and 18k-1p0b/3p0b (2xB200, 5.7-6.0 h)

automationbench.graded: by the model's collector (grade.py), minutes after its last attempt

gdpval.graded: judged 0.35-0.85 h after generation (shared judge aa-judge-qwen38-27b)

scicode.graded: CPU grading in the run, done ~1.8 h after generation ends (uval: 1578/1578 steps 3.8 h after launch); the lane closes before grading (#537)

omniscience.kind: measured on one run (uval; sb2-2p2b/4p8b ran it outside the dispatcher)

lean.basis: uval (main e678b535): server 2.97 h = 5.93 B200-h, generation 2.88 h, all scores 3.8 h after launch (SciCode CPU grading last); sb2-4p8b (frozen): 3.12 h = 6.24 B200-h; #522 (launch order) saves ~0.4 h on uval's measured durations (list schedule); the TB2.1 tail (longest attempts 140-171 min) is the floor. CPU: uval Pi workers TB2.1 98.5 + AB 14.8 + GDPval 8.3 unit-h at 10-CPU TB2.1 workers; worker_profile slow halves TB2.1 (rtab: 51.3 vs 99.9 unit-h at 128 in flight), + clients, collector, graders ~10.

full.basis: m5l-sb-full (4xB200, budget 512, 9 suites): server 3.86 h = 15.42 B200-h incl. canary 1.03 and idle 0.87, 1317 attempt-hours; list-scheduled on 256 slots 5.2 h (oracle) - 5.6 h (actual order). 2xB200 9-suite runs (18k-3p0b / 18k-1p0b, weaker models, 2-h caps, canary): 6.24 h = 12.5 and 7.74 h = 15.5 B200-h. CPU: sb-full's TB-Sci-lite 156 + CritPt 74 unit-h on top of the lean set (before #538 claim packing).

sources.ucab-sb10b-t10: val-codeab 11-19 (#480 comment 7015700314): main e678b535, TB2.1/AB/GDPval, T 1.0
